title: Talking about free time
summary: Infinitives after люблю / обожнюю, instrumental after цікавитися / займатися, unchanged хобі.

timeacc.note: Accusative: what is planned takes the accusative.

timeins.sentenceGloss: Know how to use your free time.
timeins.note: Instrumental: вільний час in the instrumental, as the means of spending time.

interest.sentenceGloss: My brother is interested in tourism.

collect.sentenceGloss: Olena is keen on collecting postcards.

read.sentenceGloss: At weekends I like to read books.
read.note: Infinitive: after любити the verb that names the action stands in the infinitive.

draw.note: Infinitive: after обожнює the verb that names the action stands in the infinitive.

sphere.sentenceGloss: His field of interest is design.
sphere.note: Genitive plural: інтересів after the noun that names the field.

hobby.sentenceGloss: The female friend has no new hobby.
hobby.note: Indeclinable: хобі has no case, so it stays the same.

new.sentenceGloss: I am choosing a new hobby.
new.note: Accusative: the adjective agrees with хобі, which is neuter here.

plural.note: Nominative plural: the adjective is plural here.

leisure.sentenceGloss: In our free time we read.
leisure.note: Locative singular: дозвілля in the second case singular.

devote.sentenceGloss: My sister devotes her evenings to music.
devote.note: Dative: присвячує takes the dative — what the evenings are given to.
